props.heading: Best trips from Phoenix on a budget
props.subheading: Real flight, hotel, and activity costs for the destinations that actually fit what you have to spend — flying out of PHX.

props.text: Phoenix is one of just a few hubs — with Denver, LA, and San Francisco — that gets a daily nonstop to Aspen all winter, a real way to trade desert heat for snow. Flying out of PHX, a trip to Oaxaca can start around $1,096 for flight, hotel, and activities together — not just the flight, pulled from our own cost data, not guesses.

features.title: Las Vegas — nonstop, ~1h16m
features.text: Southwest, American, and Frontier all fly it direct — one of Phoenix's busiest short-haul routes.

features.title: Oaxaca — nonstop, but seasonal only
features.text: American runs it nonstop for a limited part of the year; outside that window it connects via Dallas or Houston instead.

features.title: Aspen — nonstop, ~2h, daily in ski season
features.text: American flies it nonstop daily from November through March.

props.text: Las Vegas is a short, direct hop that fits Phoenix's well-worn weekend circuit. Aspen stands out: Phoenix is one of only a handful of hubs we cover (alongside Denver, LA, and San Francisco) with daily nonstop winter ski service — a genuinely convenient way to escape the desert heat for snow. Oaxaca's nonstop is seasonal only, so most of the year it's a deliberate connection-required trip rather than an easy booking.

items.question: Are these real-time prices?
items.answer: They're estimates based on our own curated cost data for this route and season, not a live quote — the real price on the partner site may be a bit higher or lower depending on exact dates.

items.question: Is Aspen doable as a weekend ski trip from Phoenix?
items.answer: Yes — American flies nonstop daily in ski season, about 2 hours each way, which is notably easier than from Seattle or Las Vegas, neither of which has any nonstop Aspen service at all.

items.question: Is there a direct flight to Oaxaca from Phoenix?
items.answer: Only seasonally — American runs it nonstop for part of the year; the rest of the year expect a connection via Dallas or Houston.
